observations.description: No network/credential/live/scheduler imports. Only dataclass, datetime, enum, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, uuid, checkpoint, gateway used. trading_authority=False in lock, health, and heartbeat.

Exclusive ownership: O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock, two supervisors cannot own same root, missing root rejects, malformed/foreign lock rejects on cycle and release, failed acquisition no modify, no cross-delete, release only owned, no stale-lock assumption.

Initialization: requires checkpoint or explicit initial, existing checkpoint forces connected=false + reconciliation_required=true, kill switch preserved on restart, corrupted/missing checkpoint fails closed.

Heartbeat: content-addressed (sha256 of core), binds session_id+state+timestamps+snapshot_id+kill_switch+reconciliation+stop+trading_authority, deterministic, atomic (open xb+flush+fsync+os.replace), temp cleaned in finally, no unrelated deletion.

Stale/future: age at maximum accepted (<=), above maximum halts (HALTED_STALE_INPUT), future by any amount halts (HALTED_FUTURE_INPUT), both activate kill switch + disconnect + reconciliation, halted checkpointed before health, halted cannot recover without reconciliation, naive/non-UTC reject.

Controlled stop: bound to exact session_id, requires stop=True + trading_authority=False, malformed/foreign/false/extra-field/authority-bearing reject, STOPPED health durably recorded, preserves gateway state, stale stop cannot control future session.
Ordering: ownership checked before commands (cycle/load), checkpoint saved before heartbeat, context manager releases on exception and success, exceptions don't mask ownership loss.
Policy: positive durations required, session_id must be 32-char lowercase UUID hex, health state is closed enum (4 values), trading_authority cannot be set True (frozen dataclass).
Integration: uses PaperGatewayCheckpointStoreV1 (not parallel persistence), snapshot_id authoritative, no pickle.
